miners.name: VulnFeed On-Chain Security Intelligence
miners.description: Deterministic smart-contract security miner for Base. Given an EVM contract address, fetches verified source from Sourcify or Blockscout and returns a structured Slither risk report with ratings, severity counts, exploit probability, and per-finding details.

miners.name: Verity On-Chain Transaction Lookup
miners.description: Deterministic EVM transaction lookups with a compact canonical payload for ground-truth evaluation.
